items.caption:
Why do I wake up before my alarm? One small study's clue.
In a 1999 lab study, people expecting a 6 a.m. wake-up showed a rise in the hormone ACTH about an hour before. Those woken by surprise did not.

items.caption:
Two men tried to live a 28-hour day.
In 1938 Nathaniel Kleitman and Bruce Richardson spent 32 days in Mammoth Cave trying to live on 28-hour days. Kleitman never adjusted.
